India and EU Finalize Free Trade Agreement

External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar has praised the finalization of a Free Trade Agreement (FTA) between India and the European Union. He stated that the agreement will open up an enormous and mature market, providing access to a huge European market with strong purchasing power.
